correctness.rationale: For standard irrational rotation and Lebesgue-uniform initial phase, discontinuities of sorting n real orbit representatives are the n cuts -j*alpha mod 1. Between cuts the permutation is constant, and each gap gives a distinct linear ordering, so raw H_n is exactly Shannon entropy of the n gap lengths. For successive continued-fraction denominators q,Q, the q points are within 1/Q of a permuted q-grid, so for n>=q every gap <=1/q+2/Q<=3/q and H_n>=log(q/3). For n<=Q/4, each observed cut lies within delta=n/(qQ) of a q-grid boundary; outside a set of measure <=2n/Q, the pattern is determined by the grid cell. Entropy chain rule yields H_n<=log q+h(2n/Q)+(2n/Q)log n. On subsequences with log q/log Q->theta<1 choose n=floor(Q/(log Q)^2) to match H=log q+O(1); convergent denominators n=q yield limsup ratio 1. Continued-fraction identity mu=1+limsup log Q/log q establishes lower endpoint 1/(mu-1). Each added cut splits only one gap, increasing H by <=log 2; normalized adjacent jumps tend 0, so the full cluster set fills the closed interval. Independently computed golden rotation gap entropies for n=11,40,150,250 in ordinary arithmetic, confirming H/log n near 1 without claiming proof.
